head: See what's nearby on one map
where: central York (53.9601,-1.0850), Discover in map view at iPad width (1024x1366 @2x)
claim: "See what's nearby on one map": at tablet and desktop widths Discover has a map view (src/pages/Discover.jsx view toggle) plotting the deck's places, here the 50 places near central York, as in the screen.
alt: Discover map view of central York with the 50 nearby places plotted as category pins over a street map

head: Find things to do, one swipe away
where: central York (53.9601,-1.0850), Discover deck at iPad width (1024x1366 @2x)
claim: Swipe deck of things to do near the user: Discover tab (src/pages/Discover.jsx), shown in the screen itself.
alt: Discover deck at iPad size with a swipe card for York Minster, 514 m away, with skip, go and save buttons

head: A half-day out, planned in a tap
where: central York, Plan tab at iPad width, default Mix vibe and Half day, one tap on Generate itinerary from a fresh page, page clock started at 10:00
claim: "A half-day out, planned in a tap": from the Plan tab's defaults (Mix adventure, Half day), one tap on Generate itinerary builds a timed 3-stop half-day plan with a route map (src/pages/Plan.jsx; a half day is 3 stops, src/pages/Plan/constants.ts), as in the screen.
alt: Half-day plan on a York map with three numbered stops, starting at Barley Hall at 10:20, then Betty's Café Tea Rooms

head: Find any saved place in seconds
where: Saved tab at iPad width, search "museum", guest session with seven saved places in York
claim: "In seconds": the saved-places search filters on the device as you type, with no network call (src/utils/placeSearch.js); the screen shows "museum" matching three of seven saved places, all three visible.
alt: Saved places searched for "museum" at iPad size: Barley Hall, Bar Convent Museum and Micklegate Bar Museum

head: Town highlights on one page
where: /town/canterbury town guide at iPad width, All filter
claim: "Town highlights on one page": the screen is one scrolling page for Canterbury listing its top-ranked places (the in-app guide shows up to 24, src/pages/TownPage.jsx PER_TOWN = 24) with category filters. No claim about every place or every town.
alt: Canterbury town guide at iPad size listing the cathedral, Beaney House, St Augustine's Abbey, castle and museums
